# A read at a negative constant offset is rewritten while every index it reads can
# be zero or more: from a constant start at least as large as the offset, a named
# one included, which the emitted code keeps by name, and up to a constant limit
# that leaves the highest index read at zero or more. Loops whose index is a
# negative constant are left alone (see offset_negative_constant_no_rewrite.txt).

exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

loopvec -split .
! stdout .
cmpenv stderr stderr.want
cmp ops_simd.go ops_simd.go.want

env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func FirstIndexZeroConstant(dst, a []int32) {
	for i := 15; i < 31; i++ {
		dst[i] = a[i-15] + 1
	}
}

func FirstIndexZero(dst, a []int32, n int) {
	for i := 1; i < n; i++ {
		dst[i] = a[i-1] * 3
	}
}

const s1 = 1

func NamedStart(dst, a []int32, n int) {
	for i := s1; i < n; i++ {
		dst[i] = a[i-1] * 3
	}
}

func NamedStartCopy(dst, a []int32, n int) {
	for i := s1; i < n; i++ {
		dst[i] = a[i-1]
	}
}

func LastIndexZero(dst, a []int32, k int) {
	for i := k; i < 16; i++ {
		dst[i] = a[i-15] + 1
	}
}
-- ops_simd.go.want --
//go:build goexperiment.simd

package test

import (
	"simd"
	"unsafe"
)

func FirstIndexZeroConstant(dst, a []int32) {
	_vcInt32s0 := simd.BroadcastInt32s(1)
	if _loopvecOverlap(dst, a, 15, 31, 0, 31) {
		for i := 15; i < 31; i++ {
			dst[i] = a[i-15] + 1
		}
	} else {
		_ = dst[31-1]
		_ = a[31-16]
		{
			_w1 := dst[15:][:(31 - 15):(31 - 15)]
			_count := len(_w1)
			_w2 := a[0:][:_count:_count]
			_i, _lanes := 0, simd.BroadcastInt32s(0).Len()
			for ; _i <= _count-4*_lanes; _i += 4 * _lanes {
				_c1, _c2 := _w1[_i:][:4*_lanes], _w2[_i:][:4*_lanes]
				_v1 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c2)
				_v1.Add(_vcInt32s0).Store(_c1)
				_v2 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c2[_lanes:])
				_v2.Add(_vcInt32s0).Store(_c1[_lanes:])
				_v3 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c2[2*_lanes:])
				_v3.Add(_vcInt32s0).Store(_c1[2*_lanes:])
				_v4 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c2[3*_lanes:])
				_v4.Add(_vcInt32s0).Store(_c1[3*_lanes:])
			}
			for ; _i <= _count-_lanes; _i += _lanes {
				_v5 := simd.LoadInt32s(_w2[_i:])
				_v5.Add(_vcInt32s0).Store(_w1[_i:])
			}
			for _i < _count {
				_v6, _n := simd.LoadInt32sPart(_w2[_i:])
				_v6.Add(_vcInt32s0).StorePart(_w1[_i:])
				_i += _n
			}
		}
	}
}

func FirstIndexZero(dst, a []int32, n int) {
	_vcInt32s1 := simd.BroadcastInt32s(3)
	if _loopvecOverlap(dst, a, 1, n, 0, n) {
		for i := 1; i < n; i++ {
			dst[i] = a[i-1] * 3
		}
	} else {
		if n > 1 {
			_ = dst[n-1]
			_ = a[n-2]
			{
				_w1 := dst[1:][:(n - 1):(n - 1)]
				_count := len(_w1)
				_w2 := a[0:][:_count:_count]
				_i, _lanes := 0, simd.BroadcastInt32s(0).Len()
				for ; _i <= _count-4*_lanes; _i += 4 * _lanes {
					_c1, _c2 := _w1[_i:][:4*_lanes], _w2[_i:][:4*_lanes]
					_v1 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c2)
					_v1.Mul(_vcInt32s1).Store(_c1)
					_v2 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c2[_lanes:])
					_v2.Mul(_vcInt32s1).Store(_c1[_lanes:])
					_v3 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c2[2*_lanes:])
					_v3.Mul(_vcInt32s1).Store(_c1[2*_lanes:])
					_v4 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c2[3*_lanes:])
					_v4.Mul(_vcInt32s1).Store(_c1[3*_lanes:])
				}
				for ; _i <= _count-_lanes; _i += _lanes {
					_v5 := simd.LoadInt32s(_w2[_i:])
					_v5.Mul(_vcInt32s1).Store(_w1[_i:])
				}
				for _i < _count {
					_v6, _n := simd.LoadInt32sPart(_w2[_i:])
					_v6.Mul(_vcInt32s1).StorePart(_w1[_i:])
					_i += _n
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

const s1 = 1

func NamedStart(dst, a []int32, n int) {
	_vcInt32s2 := simd.BroadcastInt32s(3)
	if _loopvecOverlap(dst, a, s1, n, s1-1, n) {
		for i := s1; i < n; i++ {
			dst[i] = a[i-1] * 3
		}
	} else {
		if n > s1 {
			_ = dst[n-1]
			_ = a[n-2]
			{
				_w1 := dst[s1:][:(n - s1):(n - s1)]
				_count := len(_w1)
				_w2 := a[s1-1:][:_count:_count]
				_i, _lanes := 0, simd.BroadcastInt32s(0).Len()
				for ; _i <= _count-4*_lanes; _i += 4 * _lanes {
					_c1, _c2 := _w1[_i:][:4*_lanes], _w2[_i:][:4*_lanes]
					_v1 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c2)
					_v1.Mul(_vcInt32s2).Store(_c1)
					_v2 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c2[_lanes:])
					_v2.Mul(_vcInt32s2).Store(_c1[_lanes:])
					_v3 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c2[2*_lanes:])
					_v3.Mul(_vcInt32s2).Store(_c1[2*_lanes:])
					_v4 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c2[3*_lanes:])
					_v4.Mul(_vcInt32s2).Store(_c1[3*_lanes:])
				}
				for ; _i <= _count-_lanes; _i += _lanes {
					_v5 := simd.LoadInt32s(_w2[_i:])
					_v5.Mul(_vcInt32s2).Store(_w1[_i:])
				}
				for _i < _count {
					_v6, _n := simd.LoadInt32sPart(_w2[_i:])
					_v6.Mul(_vcInt32s2).StorePart(_w1[_i:])
					_i += _n
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

func NamedStartCopy(dst, a []int32, n int) {
	if _loopvecOverlap(dst, a, s1, n, s1-1, n) {
		for i := s1; i < n; i++ {
			dst[i] = a[i-1]
		}
	} else {
		if n > s1 {
			_ = dst[n-1]
			_ = a[n-2]
			copy(dst[s1:n], a[s1-1:])
		}
	}
}

func LastIndexZero(dst, a []int32, k int) {
	_vcInt32s4 := simd.BroadcastInt32s(1)
	if _loopvecOverlap(dst, a, k, 16, k-15, 16) {
		for i := k; i < 16; i++ {
			dst[i] = a[i-15] + 1
		}
	} else {
		if 16 > k {
			_ = dst[16-1]
			_ = a[16-16]
			{
				_w1 := dst[k:][:(16 - k):(16 - k)]
				_count := len(_w1)
				_w2 := a[k-15:][:_count:_count]
				_i, _lanes := 0, simd.BroadcastInt32s(0).Len()
				for ; _i <= _count-4*_lanes; _i += 4 * _lanes {
					_c1, _c2 := _w1[_i:][:4*_lanes], _w2[_i:][:4*_lanes]
					_v1 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c2)
					_v1.Add(_vcInt32s4).Store(_c1)
					_v2 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c2[_lanes:])
					_v2.Add(_vcInt32s4).Store(_c1[_lanes:])
					_v3 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c2[2*_lanes:])
					_v3.Add(_vcInt32s4).Store(_c1[2*_lanes:])
					_v4 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c2[3*_lanes:])
					_v4.Add(_vcInt32s4).Store(_c1[3*_lanes:])
				}
				for ; _i <= _count-_lanes; _i += _lanes {
					_v5 := simd.LoadInt32s(_w2[_i:])
					_v5.Add(_vcInt32s4).Store(_w1[_i:])
				}
				for _i < _count {
					_v6, _n := simd.LoadInt32sPart(_w2[_i:])
					_v6.Add(_vcInt32s4).StorePart(_w1[_i:])
					_i += _n
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

func _loopvecOverlap[T any](a, b []T, aLo, aHi, bLo, bHi int) bool {
	if aLo >= aHi || bLo >= bHi {
		return false
	}
	size := unsafe.Sizeof(a[0])
	aBase := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(a)))
	bBase := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(b)))
	return aBase+uintptr(aLo)*size < bBase+uintptr(bHi)*size && bBase+uintptr(bLo)*size < aBase+uintptr(aHi)*size
}
-- stderr.want --
loopvec: rewrote 5 loop(s) in $WORK/ops.go
-- testmain/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/test"
)

func try(f func()) (panicked bool) {
	defer func() { panicked = recover() != nil }()
	f()
	return
}

func ramp(n int) []int32 {
	s := make([]int32, n)
	for i := range s {
		s[i] = int32(i + 1)
	}
	return s
}

func main() {
	dst := make([]int32, 31)
	test.FirstIndexZeroConstant(dst, ramp(16))
	fmt.Println(dst)

	for _, f := range []func(dst, a []int32, n int){test.FirstIndexZero, test.NamedStart, test.NamedStartCopy} {
		dst := make([]int32, 21)
		f(dst, ramp(21), 21)
		fmt.Println(dst)
		fmt.Println(try(func() { f(make([]int32, 21), ramp(19), 21) }))
	}

	dst = make([]int32, 16)
	test.LastIndexZero(dst, ramp(1), 15)
	fmt.Println(dst)
	fmt.Println(try(func() { test.LastIndexZero(make([]int32, 16), ramp(1), 14) }))
}
